title: TUI refresh-ms flag is parsed by CLI but ignored by the TUI
description: Evidence: dashboard launch parses and forwards --refresh-ms, but apps/tui/src/index.tsx reads only --workspace and --global; RouteApp accepts no refreshMs prop and watchHead defaults to 2000ms. Impact: operators can pass a documented refresh interval with no behavior change, especially misleading for global queues/status during multi-agent work.
acceptanceCriteria: TUI entrypoint parses --refresh-ms and passes it into RouteApp/repo polling/global refresh, or the flag/docs are removed.
A regression proves --refresh-ms changes refresh cadence or is rejected as unsupported.
